sb_prompt: FIND OUT WHAT THE OTHER CALLER DOES IN THE WAY OF LAWN AND GARDEN WORK.DOES THE OTHER CALL ENJOY DOING IT?  COMPARE THIS TO YOUR OWN SITUATION.
turns: So, do you do any kind of lawn and garden work?
Yes, I do enjoy doing lawn and garden work. I find it very satisfying to see the results of my labor. What about you? Do you do any lawn and garden work?

Yes, I do enjoy lawn and garden work as well. I find it to be a great way to relax and get some fresh air. I mostly take care of my own yard, but I also help out my neighbors sometimes. How about you? Do you have any experience with lawn and garden work?
